summary: Adagio Medical Holdings filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026 disclosing a board-adopted restructuring tied to a strategic-alternatives review. The company is cutting 25 of 43 full-time employees effective immediately, incurring roughly $1.3 million of cash severance and related costs, with possible unquantified impairment charges to follow. Separately, Adagio notified holders of its 13% senior secured convertible notes that conversion pricing is lowered through October 31, 2026 to the alternate conversion price, defined as the lower of the then-effective price or 85% of the lowest five-day VWAP. The arrangement creates dilution and noteholder overhang if conversions accelerate; watch the strategic process, note conversions, and any amendment or extension beyond October 31.
